label: Default
html:
<search class="mk-search-box">
  <form action="#" method="get" role="search">
    <label class="sr-only" for="sb-1">Search</label>
    <span class="mk-search-box-field"
      ><i data-lucide="search"></i
      ><input
        class="input"
        id="sb-1"
        type="search"
        name="q"
        placeholder="Search docs, tasks and people"
        autocomplete="off"
        enterkeyhint="search"
      /><kbd class="kbd">⌘K</kbd></span
    >
    <button class="btn" type="submit">Search</button>
  </form>
</search>

label: Large
html:
<search class="mk-search-box" data-variant="large">
  <form action="#" method="get" role="search">
    <label class="sr-only" for="sb-2">Search</label>
    <select class="select" name="scope" aria-label="Search in"
      ><option>Everything</option
      ><option>Docs</option
      ><option>Tasks</option
      ><option>People</option></select
    >
    <span class="mk-search-box-field"
      ><i data-lucide="search"></i
      ><input
        class="input"
        id="sb-2"
        type="search"
        name="q"
        placeholder="Search docs, tasks and people"
        autocomplete="off"
        enterkeyhint="search"
      /><kbd class="kbd">⌘K</kbd></span
    >
    <button class="btn" type="submit">Search</button>
  </form>
</search>
